'''Kell Borean''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Homeworld/Legends|from]] the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] who frequented the [[Outlander Club/Legends|Outlander Club]] on her homeworld prior to the start of the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]] in [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]]. She seemed to be a permanent fixture around the club's [[Gambling/Legends|gambling]] tables despite not being an employee. During a [[Local day/Legends|night]] in 22 [[Galactic Standard Calendar|BBY]], Borean visited the club when the [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]] and [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]] entered to [[Plot to assassinate Senator Amidala/Legends|find]] [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] [[Zam Wesell/Legends|Zam Wesell]].

==Biography==
Kell Borean was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Coruscanti/Legends|native]] [[Homeworld/Legends|to]]<ref name="db" /> the [[Core Worlds/Legends|Core Worlds]] [[Planet/Legends|planet]]<ref name="CL">[[Star Wars: Complete Locations (2005)|''Star Wars: Complete Locations'']]</ref> [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]]. A participant in her homeworld's party scene,<ref name="Rogues">{{InsiderCite|136|Rogues Gallery|Rogues Gallery: A Night at the Outlander Club}}</ref> Borean began to frequent the [[Outlander Club/Legends|Outlander Club]],<ref name="db" /> a [[Nightclub/Legends|nightclub]] and [[Gambling/Legends|gambling]] hall located in the [[Uscru Entertainment District/Legends|Uscru Entertainment District]] of Coruscant,<ref name="CSWE2">{{CSWECite|II|431|Outlander Club}}</ref> prior to the start of the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], a conflict<ref name="db" /> between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]]<ref name="AOTC" /> that started in [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]].<ref name="NEC" /> Though Borean was not an employee of the club,<ref name="Who's Who">{{InsiderCite|75|Who's Who in the Outlander Club: It's Ladies' Night}}</ref> she<ref name="db" /> seemed to be a permanent fixture around its gambling tables.<ref name="Who's Who" /> 

During a [[Standard day/Legends|night]]<ref name="AOTC">{{Film|II}}</ref> in 22 [['ABY-BBY' dating system/Legends|BBY]],<ref name="NEC">''[[The New Essential Chronology]]'' dates the events of {{Film|II}} to [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]].</ref> Borean stood with the Human<ref name="AOTC" /> [[Eos Morne]]<ref name="Rogues" /> at the Outlander Club's bar when the [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] [[Zam Wesell/Legends|Zam Wesell]] ran into the club, after her failure [[Plot to assassinate Senator Amidala/Legends|assassinating]] [[Senator/Legends|Senator]] [[Padmé Amidala/Legends|Padmé Amidala]]. The clubgoers moved to the club's entrance before the [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]] and [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]] walked in searching for the bounty hunter. Later, she was supervising a<ref name="AOTC" /> gaming table<ref name="HeadGames">{{SWArchive|url=episode-ii/explore/attack/2002/11/imageattack20021106.html|series=Image Attack|text=Head-Games}}</ref> surrounded by several Humans. When Skywalker walked by the table, surveying the patrons, Borean gave an<ref name="AOTC" /> elated cheer<ref name="Who's Who" /> and clapped with the other Humans<ref name="AOTC" /> as the house gave a big payout.<ref name="Who's Who" />

==Personality and traits==
Borean had [[Color/Legends|black]] [[Hair/Legends|hair]]<ref name="db" /> worn in a long braid,<ref name="FF96">{{FactFile|96|OUT 1-2|Outlander Nightclub Patrons}}</ref> brown [[Eye/Legends|eyes]], and light skin.<ref name="db" /> She had a masculine given first name common amongst [[Corellian/Legends|Corellians]], the Human inhabitants of<ref name="Corellia">{{GamerCite|9|Callsigns: Names of Corellia}}</ref> the planet<ref name="core">{{FactFile|7|PLA 1-6|Planets of the Core Worlds}}</ref> [[Corellia/Legends|Corellia]].<ref name="Corellia" />

==Equipment==
While at the Outlander Club, Borean wore a light blue [[Clothing/Legends|top]], loose see-through light blue pants worn over shorts, laced white [[Boot/Legends|boots]],<ref name="CTP">''[[Star Wars Chronicles: The Prequels]]''</ref> and a large white and black [[Hat/Legends|hat]], which possibly gave her [[luck]].<ref name="Who's Who" />

==Behind the scenes==
{{Quote|Perhaps it's her "Easter parade" hat that brings her luck?|Daniel Wallace|<ref name="Who's Who" />}}
[[File:HeadGames-IA.jpg|thumb|right|250px|Australian actor Eliana Dona portrayed Kell Borean.]]
Kell Borean first appeared in the [[prequel trilogy]] film [[Star Wars: Episode II Attack of the Clones|''Star Wars'': Episode II ''Attack of the Clones'']],<ref name="AOTC" /> released on [[May 16]], [[2002]].<ref name="Year">''[[Star Wars Year by Year: A Visual Chronicle]]''</ref> In the film, Borean was portrayed by Australian actor and make-up artist [[Eliana Dona]],<ref name="Gina Stoj Management">{{WebCite|url=http://www.ginastoj.com/Actors/Female/Females%20CD/Dona,%20Eliana/actorprofile.html|text=Gina Stoj Management|work=[http://www.ginastoj.com ginastoj.com]|archivedate=20130830044412}}</ref> though she was left uncredited for her work.<ref name="AOTC" /> The Outlander Club scenes including Dona were shot at [[Fox Studios, Sydney]] on [[July 17]], [[2000]].<ref name="Mythmaking">''[[Mythmaking: Behind the Scenes of Attack of the Clones]]''</ref> 

Prior to the film's release, the character was first pictured in the web documentary "[[Making Episode II Webdocs|A Twinkle Beyond Pluto]],"<ref name="ATBP">{{SW|url=video/a-twinkle-beyond-pluto|series=Making Episode II Webdocs|text=Part 5: A Twinkle Beyond Pluto}}</ref> released on [[July 31]], [[2001]],<ref name="ATBP Date">{{SWArchive|url=episode-ii/bts/me2/archive.html|text=''Making Episode II Webdocs'' archive}}</ref> and was identified in the [[StarWars.com]] article "Making Up is Hard to Do: Lesley Vanderwalt", which was published on [[February 15]], 2002.<ref name="Lesley Vanderwalt">{{SWArchive|url=episode-ii/feature/20020215/index.html|text=Making Up is Hard to Do: Lesley Vanderwalt}}</ref> In the [[April 6]], [[2004]],<ref name="SW.com">{{SWArchive|url=community/fanclub/mag/news20040315.html|text=The New Face of Evil}}</ref> article "[[Who's Who in the Outlander Club: It's Ladies' Night]]," published in the [[Star Wars Insider 75|seventy-fifth issue]] of the ''[[Star Wars Insider]]'' magazine, author [[Daniel Wallace]] described Borean's hat as an "[[Wikipedia:Easter parade|Easter parade]]" hat.<ref name="Who's Who" />
